svg.title: Opus Sectile: plan
svg.desc: Plan of an inlaid stone floor: square panels each holding a lozenge and a round disc of contrasting stone, framed by bands of marble. Source: Original drawing by Project Exodus from the standard geometric construction of this form; no external drawing reproduced.

g.text: CUT COLOURED STONE INLAID IN GEOMETRIC PANELS
SOURCE: Original drawing by Project Exodus from the standard
geometric construction of this form; no external drawing
SCALE IN FIFTHS OF A PANEL
